items.title: Fairer SMS safeguards and shorter pauses
items.why: Standard texting pauses drop to 12 hours, judged on a rolling 7 days. Rolling out to selected sub-accounts.

items.title: Even and weighted splits in workflows
items.why: Send leads to each rep in turn, or give one team a bigger share by the percentages you set.

items.title: One-click cleanup for old workflows
items.why: Workflow Maps flags unused workflows, default names and empty folders so you can review and tidy up.

items.title: AI agents can now make short branded films
items.why: Managed Agents create multi-shot videos up to 60 seconds with captions and end cards. Billed per second.

items.title: Tax forms and payout setup for affiliates
items.why: Collect signed terms, W9 or W8 forms and payout details, with a Compliance column. New Client Portal only.
